title: anil ultima
intro: Anil ultima, commonly known as Ailanthus altissima, is a deciduous tree native to Asia, but widely naturalized in other parts of the world. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as a diuretic and laxative. The therapeutic actions of Anil ultima include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal applications. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
